commit_message: Implement ADR 0139 working-copy authority core on current main
pr_body:
Implements ADR 0139 authoritative Editor working-copy and saved-copy coherency on current main, preserving ADR 0138 Animation Graph debug provenance.

- keeps existing workspace and specialized editor sessions as the single mutable owners
- supplies immutable working-copy snapshots to Problems validation and Play
- removes Material canonical autosave and makes persistence explicit through Save/Save All
- makes Animation Set consume an open Animation Graph working copy
- preserves ADR 0138 semantic GraphId/EdgeId observation metadata while compiling unsaved graph snapshots

A follow-up request on the same task branch completes Scene View snapshot consumption and external-file conflict UI before final validation.
